# Southern Cubing welcomes you to Fort Worth for Southern Championship 2026!

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTI1NzUyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--93ed8c64ab3237522f6a77aeaf7a38f7b6469e82/Southerns%202026%20Logo%202-05.png)

### **Please visit the [Key Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SouthernChampionship2026#63383-key-information) tab for an overview of everything Southern Champs 2026!**

The highest placing resident of Arkansas, Louisiana, Mississippi, Oklahoma or Texas in each event at this competition will be recognized as the Southern Champion! Check out the [Southern Championship Eligibility](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SouthernChampionship2026#63392-southern-champion-eligibility) tab for more information.

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [New Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SouthernChampionship2026#63385-new-competitor-information-and-faq) tab.

Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating.

This competition is organized by [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/) and supported by our [sponsors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SouthernChampionship2026#63391-sponsors-and-partners).
